title: Housing Security Anti Eviction and Urban Land Equity Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal for prohibition of forced evictions/demolitions without judicial hearing, mandatory 90-day notice, 30% urban land pooling quota for low-income housing, and statutory title security for long-term informal settlements.
notes: Matter 013: Housing Security Anti Eviction and Urban Land Equity Bill, 2026.
